description: Maintained catalog of known AI coding agent CLIs. The dashboard merges this list with live detection: entries installed on the machine appear under Installed; the rest appear under Available to Install. Add a new agent here (and bump `version`) to surface it in the GUI. Install/uninstall commands are the ONLY commands the dashboard is allowed to execute. `binaries` are the CLI probe targets; `settingsPaths` lets non-adapter entries (reasonix, freebuff) be detected by their config footprint too.

agents.name: OpenAI Codex (chatgpt)
agents.description: OpenAI's coding agent CLI (binaries: codex / chatgpt). Installed via bun on this machine.
agents.note: Uses bun. If bun is not installed, install with: npm install -g bun

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.description: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI for the terminal.
agents.note: Uninstall is manual for the native installer: remove ~/.local/share/claude and the `claude` binary. On Windows use https://claude.ai/install.ps1

agents.name: OpenCode
agents.description: The open-source terminal coding agent (Rust core, extensible).
agents.note: The uninstall command applies to the Homebrew install. npm alternative: npm i -g opencode-ai@beta

agents.name: Kilo Code
agents.description: Kilo Code CLI (VS Code extension family + terminal CLI).

agents.name: Pi
agents.description: Pi — the lightweight coding agent from the Pi / cmux stack.

agents.name: Gemini CLI
agents.description: Google Gemini CLI — Google's coding agent in your terminal.

agents.name: Junie
agents.description: JetBrains Junie — coding agent CLI from the JetBrains ecosystem.
agents.note: Installed by the JetBrains installer script — install or update manually from your JetBrains account.

agents.name: Oh My Pi
agents.description: Oh My Pi (omp) — wrapper around Pi with a Rust core + Bun runtime.
agents.note: Custom curl installer (Rust core + Bun). Please install or uninstall manually.

agents.name: Reasonix
agents.description: DeepSeek-native coding agent engineered for byte-stable prefix-cache performance. Requires Node >= 22.
agents.note: DeepSeek API key required at first run.

agents.name: FreeBuff
agents.description: Free, ad-supported coding agent CLI. No API key, account, or config file needed. Requires Node >= 18.
agents.note: Funded by text ads — usage is free.
